intro: The platinum takes about 200 hours and one playthrough (PowerPyx: difficulty 4/10, no online trophies, no mission medals, no mission replay). Play the story first, then clean up the 100% checklist in free-roam, then the strangers and the one-offs. Nothing is missable except, possibly, one meditation in Chapter 1.

stages.text: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but there are 15 manual save slots: keep a save at the start and end of each chapter (10 saves), and rotate the other 5 for free-roam cleanup. The only trophy that can be missed is Positive Mental Attitude — do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (see the Missables tab).
stages.title: Before you start — saves and the one missable

stages.text: Play Chapters 1–4 and the final mission. Story trophies pop as you go. Do the optional questlines as they appear — Andy (Chapter 3, Lucia only), Kenton (Chapter 1), Billy (Chapter 2), Randy and Tyrone (Chapter 3), Bret (Chapter 2, Jason only), Cal's fishing (Chapter 1) — all of them stay available after the story, so do not rush them. While travelling, scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with the binoculars: progress counts toward 100% even before the checklist becomes visible.
stages.title: Step 1 — Finish the story

stages.text: After the story, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. It is lenient — about 60% true completion. The big numbers: scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals, complete 300 stunts, any 70 of 80 challenges, any 100 optional missions, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 target decks, 42 shooting-range gold medals, drone races at all 14 locations, 15 of 18 meditation spots, and 3 collectible card sets. Everything here is still available in free-roam.
stages.title: Step 2 — The 100% checklist

stages.text: Finish the 8 stranger strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more), the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the combat and robbery one-offs, the money and property trophies, and the five trophies whose methods are still unconfirmed at launch — check their guides for the latest word before guessing.
stages.title: Step 3 — Strangers, partners and cleanup

stages.text: Vice Got a Price! pops the moment the other 54 are done. No extra task, no multiplayer, no DLC.
stages.title: Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
